items.originalTitle: Oscar Piastri compares COTA bump to a "motocross jump" after US GP qualifying
items.summaryEn: McLaren's Oscar Piastri compared the bump on the approach to Turn 1 at the Circuit of the Americas to "a motocross jump" after qualifying seventh for the United States Grand Prix. He finished 0.768 seconds behind polesitter Kimi Antonelli, while his team-mate Lando Norris was eighth after losing his final Q3 lap time to track limits.
detailZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里警告，COTA的颠簸可能在美国大奖赛上成为超车隐患。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里将COTA一号弯的颠簸比作“越野摩托车跳台”。
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，包括车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新动态。
迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在美国大奖赛排位赛获得第七后，将COTA一号弯入口处的颠簸比作“越野摩托车跳台”。
这位澳大利亚车手落后杆位得主、当前积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利0.768秒，他的队友兰多·诺里斯因在第三节排位赛最后一圈超出赛道限制而被取消成绩，最终排名第八。
整个周末，赛道表面一直是热议话题，四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘曾将颠簸形容为“不可接受”。皮亚斯特里虽然表示大部分赛道表面相比去年已有所改善，但特别指出1号弯和19号弯的刹车区是问题区域。
当被问及对赛道表面的看法时，皮亚斯特里解释道：“大部分赛道可能比前几年要好。但进入1号弯的那个颠簸有点像越野摩托的跳跃，而进入19号弯的那个也好不了多少。”
“所以在排位赛里还不算太糟，因为你是在颠簸之后才刹车。但明天的正赛里，你恰恰就在那个颠簸上刹车。尤其是当你在1号弯尝试超越别人的时候。”
皮亚斯特里补充说，车手们已经向国际汽联提出了这个问题。
“我们已经和国际汽联谈过了。他们知道这件事。我相信明年会解决的，”他补充道。
这位25岁的车手还被问及俯瞰1号弯的新建筑，以及载着观众往返的缆车，是否改变了他的参照点。这座最先进的俱乐部会所为2026年的比赛而引入，为会员提供全年使用赛道及其设施的机会，以及许多其他福利。
“其实没有，”皮亚斯特里解释道。“只是氛围更浓了一些。活动更多了一些。以前我们看天空，现在有了……你能看到缆车里多了不少人。”
“第一次我心想，好吧，那挺接近的。但之后，我觉得这在某些方面增添了氛围。所以，并没有太大改变。”
detailEn: Oscar Piastri warns COTA bumps could become an overtaking hazard at US GP
Oscar Piastri likened a bump at Circuit of the Americas’ Turn 1 to a “motocross jump”
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
McLaren's Oscar Piastri has compared the bump on the approach to Turn 1 at the Circuit of the Americas to "a motocross jump" after qualifying seventh for the United States Grand Prix.

The Australian driver finished 0.768 seconds behind polesitter and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli, with his team-mate Lando Norris eighth after losing his final Q3 lap time to a track limits infringement.

The track surface has been a major talking point all weekend, after four-time champion Max Verstappen described the bumps as "unacceptable". While Piastri claimed the majority of the track surface has been improved from last year, he singled out the braking zones for Turns 1 and 19 as problem areas.

"The majority of the track is probably better than what it has been in previous years," Piastri explained when asked for his opinion of the track surface. "But the bump into Turn 1 is a bit like a motocross jump. And the one into Turn 19 is not that much better.
"So, in qualifying it's not too bad because you brake after the bump. But in the race tomorrow, you're braking right on that bump. Especially if you're overtaking someone into Turn 1."
Piastri added that the drivers had raised the issue with the FIA.
"We've spoken with the FIA about it. They're aware. And I'm sure it'll be fixed for next year," he added.

The 25-year-old was also asked about the new building overlooking Turn 1, complete with cable cars carrying spectators, and whether it had changed his reference points. The state-of-the-art clubhouse was introduced for the 2026 race and offers members year-round access to the track and its facilities, among many other perks.
"Not really," Piastri explained. "There's just a bit more atmosphere. There's a bit more going on. Before, we looked at the sky and now you've got... You can see a few more people in the cable cars.
"The first time I was like, OK, that's pretty close. But after that, I think it adds to the atmosphere in some ways. So, it's not changed much."

keyPointsEn: Piastri warned that the COTA bumps could become an overtaking hazard at the US Grand Prix.

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris laments "very bad job" in qualifying for F1 United States GP
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris was frustrated with his "very bad job" in qualifying for the United States Grand Prix, ending up eighth after a track-limits breach cost him a quicker time.
detailZh: 诺里斯不满美国大奖赛排位赛中的“非常糟糕的表现”
这位迈凯伦车手起初排名第六，但因超出赛道限制被罚，在COTA举行的周日F1大奖赛正赛中降至第八位发车
诺里斯在美国大奖赛排位赛中对自己的“非常糟糕的表现”感到极其沮丧，尽管他认为前排发车是可能的，最终却只排名第八。
这位卫冕世界冠军将与迈凯伦队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里同处第四排发车，尽管他在第三节排位赛第二次尝试中一度升至第六，但该圈成绩因在19号弯超出赛道限制而被取消。他第一次尝试所创造的成绩仅够排名第八。
这延续了迈凯伦令人失望的走势，他们在过去三场大奖赛中均未能登上领奖台，在梅赛德斯和法拉利身后，被红牛在赛车研发上超越。
尽管MCL40在直线速度和慢弯表现上存在弱点，诺里斯仍认为他在奥斯汀本可以取得更大成就。
“今天赛车在速度方面非常强劲，”他说，“但驾驶起来极其困难。
“这可能是我一生中开过最难驾驶的赛车。但它足以拿到第二名，所以我本应是第二，而我是第八，显然，我今天做得非常糟糕。”
因此诺里斯仍然认为在周日的正赛中取得不错的积分回报是可能的，尤其是在第一节排位赛（Q1）中排名第一之后——尽管许多其他车手使用的是中性胎而非软胎。
尽管如此，这位英国车手最终在排位赛中的成绩落后于梅赛德斯杆位得主安东内利一秒，落后红牛车队第二名的马克斯·维斯塔潘0.835秒。
“赛车很快，只是驾驶起来很棘手，”诺里斯补充道。“我看到了一个好结果，这是可能的。我认为我仍然相信我们明天能取得好成绩。
“我不知道超车会有多容易之类的事情。但是，在赛道的很多地方，我们似乎不相上下。
“我们在第三赛段很挣扎，速度非常慢。说实话，我们相当糟糕。但明天是新的一天。”
让这位26岁车手更沮丧的是，迈凯伦已将今年最后一轮升级套件的第一阶段带到得克萨斯，其中包括修改后的前悬挂几何结构和调整过的扩散器轮廓。
安东内利，梅赛德斯，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
“我们每次都努力改进，”诺里斯说。“我们改进赛车，带来升级。”
“但这是我们还没有完全……我不知道，可能是赛车就是不够快，因此总抱有希望，觉得我能跑出一圈超神圈速，拿到第一名。
“但你提升了三个弯角，另外三个突然就成了噩梦。这根本不可能。目前这辆车不可能达到我想要的那种完美。
“这很挣扎，因为我想去争杆位，却得告诉自己接受第五名，我不想这样。”
皮亚斯特里那边也同样苦恼，这位澳大利亚车手称“我远没有达到自己想要的竞争力水平”。
detailEn: Lando Norris laments "very bad job" in qualifying for F1 United States GP
The McLaren driver initially took sixth before a track-limits breach dropped him to eighth for Sunday's Formula 1 grand prix at COTA
Lando Norris was incredibly frustrated by his “very bad job” in qualifying for Formula 1’s United States Grand Prix as he took eighth despite thinking a front row was possible.

The reigning world champion will share row four with McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri, despite briefly taking sixth with his second Q3 run before that time was struck off because he had exceeded track limits at Turn 19. The time he had set on his first run was only good for eighth.
It continues a disappointing run for McLaren which has failed to score a podium in the last three grands prix, having been outdeveloped by Red Bull behind Mercedes and Ferrari.
But despite the weaknesses of the MCL40 in straightline speed and slow-corner performance, Norris still reckons he could have achieved much more in Austin.
“The car was very strong today in terms of pace,” he said. “Insanely difficult to drive.
“Probably the hardest car I've ever had to drive in my life. But good enough for P2, so I should be P2 and I'm P8, so clearly, I did a very bad job today.”
So Norris still reckons a good points return is possible in Sunday’s race, especially having topped Q1 - though many others used medium rubber and not softs.
Nevertheless, the Briton ultimately qualified a second off Mercedes polesitter Kimi Antonelli and 0.835s behind second-placed Max Verstappen for Red Bull.
“The car was quick, it's just nasty to drive,” added Norris. “I saw a good result, it's possible. I think I still have faith that we can get a good result tomorrow.
“I don't know how easy it's going to be to overtake and things like that. But, for a lot of the track, we seem on par.
“We struggle a lot in sector three and there's very slow speed. We're pretty dreadful, honestly. But tomorrow is a new day.”

What makes it more frustrating for the 26-year-old is that McLaren has brought the first stage of its final upgrade package of the year to Texas, featuring a revised front suspension geometry and an altered diffuser profile.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
“We try and improve it every time,” said Norris. “We improve the car, we bring upgrades.
“But it's something we're not completely... I don't know, it might be that the car is just not quick enough and therefore there's always hope that I can do a mega lap and I can be P1.
“But you improve three corners and the other three are a nightmare all of a sudden. It's just impossible. It's an impossible car to achieve the perfection that I want to achieve at the minute.
“Which is a struggle, because I want to go for pole, and I need to tell myself to settle for a P5, and I don't want to do that.”
The woes were present on Piastri’s side as well, with the Australian claiming “I’ve not been anywhere near as competitive as what I wanted to be”.
keyPointsZh: 诺里斯在第三节排位赛第二次尝试中一度升至第六，但因19号弯超出赛道限制该圈成绩被取消
他第一次尝试的成绩仅够排名第八，正赛将与队友皮亚斯特里同处第四排发车
keyPointsEn: Norris briefly took sixth on his second Q3 run, but that time was deleted for exceeding track limits at Turn 19.
His first-run time was only good for eighth, so he will share row four with team-mate Oscar Piastri.

为红牛车迷而设。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术解析与比赛分析。
在美国大奖赛排位赛中位列第二后，维斯塔潘表示，对自己的表现“没必要微笑、也没必要特别高兴”。第三节排位赛（Q3）中缺乏抓地力，使他无法争夺杆位，杆位由梅赛德斯的安东内利获得。
这位红牛车手在美洲赛道最终落后这位年轻的意大利车手0.179秒，并且仅领先第三名的队友伊萨克·哈贾尔0.036秒——这是哈贾尔迄今为止最好的排位赛成绩。但尽管这位荷兰车手在排位赛早些时候看起来是杆位的有力争夺者，却因意外缺乏抓地力而未能如愿。
“第一节和第二节排位赛我感觉真的很好。我的意思是，我在第二节排位赛的第一圈用的是旧胎，”他说。“所以当我进入第三节排位赛时，我抱有很高的期望，但不幸的是，感觉就是很差。就像我并没有真正获得我想要的抓地力，所以我在最后一段无法像我希望的那样依靠后轮，这让我损失了太多时间。”
“然后我的意思是，当你看看成绩表，你从第二位发车，这很好，是个不错的结果，但我本希望更多，这次就是没能做到。但如果，比如说，排位赛感觉不太好，然后还能拿到第二名，我会接受的。但没必要为此就微笑并超级开心。”
他在第二节排位赛只跑了六圈以节省轮胎，但否认了从旧胎换到新胎是罪魁祸首的说法。
“正常情况下没问题。我以前做过很多次了。我甚至有一次只用两套轮胎就完成了排位赛，”他透露。“所以是的，无法解释为什么在Q3就是没能凑到一起，或者除了最后一圈之外，我认为每个人都在为圈速挣扎。但这是我们必须研究的事情，因为当然很奇怪，你在一套用过的轮胎上感觉最好。”
这对红牛来说仍然是一个强劲的成绩，哈贾尔在Q2用旧胎感觉也不错，紧随其后排在第三。
维斯塔潘是本周末这条赛道最激烈的批评者，他在周四将COTA的颠簸描述为“不可接受”和“失控”。从第一排发车，他将有机会在进入1号弯的上坡路段攻击安东内利，那里正是颠簸最严重的地方。
维斯塔潘以221分位列积分榜第四，在马来西亚和新加坡获胜后，他正在追逐三连胜。
detailEn: Max Verstappen refuses to celebrate US GP qualifying result: 'No need to smile'
Max Verstappen was left frustrated after qualifying second behind Kimi Antonelli for the United States Grand Prix
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

After qualifying second for the United States Grand Prix, Max Verstappen has said there is "no need to smile and be super happy" about his performance. A lack of grip in Q3 left him unable to fight for pole, which instead went to Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli.

The Red Bull driver ended up 0.179 seconds behind the young Italian at the Circuit of the Americas, and only 0.036s ahead of team-mate Isack Hadjar in third - his best qualifying result yet. But while the Dutchman was looking to be a pole contender earlier in the session, an unexpected lack of grip left him wanting more.

“Q1 and Q2 I felt really good. I mean, I did my first lap in Q2 just on a used set," he said. "So when I went to Q3, I had high hopes, but unfortunately, it just felt bad. Like I just didn’t really have the grip that I wanted, so I couldn’t lean on the rear that I wanted in the final sector and that just cost me too much time.

"And then I mean, when you look at the sheets and you are starting P2 it's nice and it’s a good result, but I was hoping for more and this was just not it. But if it’s, let’s say, not a great feeling in qualifying and then that’s a P2, I’ll take it. But there’s no need to then smile and be super happy about it.”
He ran only six laps in Q2 to save tyres, but rejected the suggestion that the switch from used to fresh rubber was to blame.

“No problem normally. I’ve done that many times before. I’ve even qualified once with only two sets," he revealed. "So yeah, there is no explanation why in Q3 it just didn’t come together, or apart from the last lap where I think everyone struggled for lap time. But it’s something that we have to look at because it’s very odd of course that you have, let’s say, the best feeling on a used set.”
It is still a strong result for Red Bull, with Hadjar, who also felt good on used tyres in Q2, directly behind him in third.

Verstappen has been the circuit’s loudest critic this weekend, after describing the bumps at COTA as “unacceptable” and “out of control” on Thursday. From the front row, he will have the chance to attack Antonelli up the hill into Turn 1, where the worst of those bumps sit.
Verstappen, fourth in the standings on 221 points, is chasing a third straight victory after success in Malaysia and Singapore.
